reviews.text: I really liked the service I received. Good advice.
Amazing experience with my pet dog at Viladogcat. First visit was about an hour and the vet explained everything to me super clearly and cleared any doubts that I had. Cannot recommend them enough!
Many thanks to Paula, who helped me and completed the necessary documents for my trip with my cat. Everyone was very professional and friendly. I highly recommend them.

They are very friendly and professional. Paula operated on my dog ​​Cuscús in an emergency, and everything went perfectly. It's so nice to have a neighborhood vet who knows you by name. Cuscús has been happy since her operation. She's like a puppy again, jumping and skipping. The scar has healed so well you can barely see it. Perhaps the clinic is a little busy at times. And they could make a little effort to speak Catalan. Keep up the great work, team!
An excellent clinic. The staff's attention is perfect, professional and ethical. They have treated Pruna with great care and affection and we have felt in very good hands at all times.
Hello Antonio, we don't have any record under your name. Could you please tell us the reason for your dissatisfaction so we can improve? Thank you.

They're our dogs' vets! We trust them completely and recommend them to neighbors and friends. We're delighted. Paula, Albert, Alberto, and Berta, not forgetting Fuco, are all so friendly and professional with our furry friends 😊 …

The staff is so nice and helpful! We felt very comfortable and welcome when bringing our dog here. Dr. Belen is very kind and she is bilingual, which was very helpful to us, as we are still learning Spanish.

I only have words of gratitude for the team at Viladogcat Veterinarians. I have a pet who is quite frail and has to visit the clinic frequently, and the humane treatment and care they give her is unbeatable. It's so important for them and for us. Thank you so much 🙏🏻 …

A very negative experience at this clinic, especially due to the reception staff.

I took my 8-year-old German Shepherd in for a flea problem (despite him always wearing a Seresto collar). They gave me an appointment for Wednesday, six days after my visit on Thursday, claiming they were "overwhelmed." While excessive, I could understand that. What's unreasonable is that, with an active problem, the only solution is to wait almost a week without offering any basic alternatives. They wouldn't even provide spot-on treatments or pills, directing me directly to a pet store.

Days later, a different problem arose (unrelated to fleas): my dog ​​had a significant limp, to the point where he could barely walk or go outside. I called, and the response was the same: to wait for the Wednesday appointment. So, do they not offer an emergency service during regular business hours, even for an extra fee, like most veterinary clinics?

I had to call a vet who came to my house in less than two hours. I paid €110 and was very happy with the service. My German Shepherd can walk perfectly today.

In short: poor service, overbooked appointments, and no ability to respond to urgent cases. It seems like they're only good for routine checkups and vaccinations. I absolutely do not recommend them.
